ocr.notes: Short text with errors ('pugilltst oi', 'the Woue', 'Ai pening'); the image reads 'retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street. Free concert every evening. The best singers only engaged.'

title.suggested: Tom Allen's concert saloon notice at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's sporting notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, September 19, 1891, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen advertised his saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, as the place of the "retired champion pugilist of the world," with a free concert every evening

notes: A recurring paid reading notice placed under 'Sporting Notes', not a news item. The current title ('Announces Retirement From Prize Ring') is misleading: the notice only calls him a retired champion.
